data.title: This video provides a tutorial on integrating Meta
data.content:
## Summary
This video provides a tutorial on integrating Meta's Llama AI into custom applications for free using the OpenRouter API. It covers obtaining an API key, selecting the Llama 3.3 70B model, and building a functional chatbot using JavaScript and the Marked library.

## Key Points
- Meta Llama is an open-source series of LLMs for NLP and coding tasks.
- OpenRouter provides a platform to access various AI models via a unified API, including free tiers.
- Llama's open-source nature allows for customization without sharing data with Meta.
- The implementation uses a simple HTML/JavaScript frontend to communicate with the AI model.
- The Marked library is essential for converting the AI's markdown responses into structured HTML.

## AI Concepts
Large Language Models (LLMs), Natural Language Processing (NLP), Open Source AI, API (Application Programming Interface), Llama 3.3 70B Instruct, Text Generation
